product_metadata.title: SWOMMOLY Wall Mount Spice Rack, 6 Pack Large-capacity Spice Racks, Stackable Foldable Spice Cans Organizer Shelf, Black
features: Large-capacity design, with the same wall area, provides twice as much storage space as traditional products. Jars not included.
The rack can work as an entire 6-tier rack or 6 single racks according to your needs. You can fold the racks to save space when not in use.
Made of quality steel with fine black finish, stable and durable for a lifetime.
Rack size, entire 6-tier rack: 16.54"L x 4.57"W x 33.78"H, single tier rack: 16.54"L x 4.57"W x 5.51"H
